variant_clingx.ann: Allele A is associated with decreased catalytic activity of CYP2B6 when assayed with efavirenz by recombinant protein expressed in Sf21 cells as compared to allele G.
Allele A is associated with decreased catalytic activity of CYP2B6 when assayed with bupropion by recombinant protein expressed in Sf21 cells as compared to allele G.

anns.ann: The CYP2C9*33 allele has been assigned as a no function allele by CPIC. Patients carrying the *33 allele in combination with a normal, decreased, or no function allele may have decreased metabolism/clearance of phenytoin as compared to patients with two normal function alleles. This annotation only covers the pharmacokinetic relationship between CYP2C9 and phenytoin and does not include evidence about clinical outcomes. Other genetic and clinical factors may also influence phenytoin metabolism.

variant_clingx.ann: Allele A is not associated with expression of CYP2C9 as compared to allele G.
Allele A is associated with increased severity of Hypercholesterolemia when treated with atorvastatin or simvastatin as compared to allele G.

anns.ann: Patients carrying the CYP2C19*33 allele may have decreased enzyme activity of CYP2C19 as compared to patients with the CYP2C19*1 allele when assayed with omeprazole. Note that this allele has been assigned as an uncertain function allele by CPIC. This annotation only covers the pharmacokinetic relationship between CYP2C19 and omeprazole and does not include evidence about clinical outcomes. Other genetic and clinical factors may also influence the metabolism of omeprazole.

variant_clingx.ann: Allele A is not associated with expression of CYP2C19 as compared to allele G.
Allele A is associated with decreased clearance of fluoxetine in insect microsomes as compared to allele G.

anns.ann: Patients with the CYP2D6*48 allele may have similar enzyme activity of CYP2D6 as compared to patients with the CYP2D6*1 allele. The CYP2D6*48 allele was found to have similar enzyme activity compared to CYP2D6*1 during in-vitro characterization with bufuralol. Other genetic and clinical factors may also influence the metabolism of bufuralol.
